goal: At least 65% pure wins against all 15 frozen opponents
metric: wins / all games; draws are not wins
seeds: Every match has its own unique seed, disjoint from all known prior registered seeds

training.method: Joint teacher-data fine tuning; predicted previous-action exposure; not on-policy DAgger
training.trainable: Shared Transformer, unit type/quantity, market skeleton/quantity heads

cpu.scope: Only owned job and descendants are throttled; unrelated activity can exceed whole-machine ceiling
